about.p1: United Automotive Consultants is a trusted auto broker proudly serving drivers all throughout New Jersey.
about.p2: Founded by a former dealership manager with over 10 years of hands-on experience we understand exactly how frustrating and time-consuming the car-buying process can be especially when you're negotiating on your own.
about.p3: That's why we built a better way: one dedicated broker who handles everything for you from start to finish.
about.p4: We specialize in securing the best purchase price on the vehicle you want, while shopping top insurance carriers for the lowest possible rates. We work with every credit situation, making the process smooth and stress-free.
about.p5: You'll work directly with one experienced broker who negotiates for you. Never for the dealership or insurer. No hidden fees. No pressure. Just transparent, reliable service from start to finish.

why.title: Why Us
why.p1: One Dedicated Broker, Two Major Savings We handle both your car purchase and auto insurance under one roof — saving you time and delivering better deals than shopping separately.
why.p2: Expert Negotiation on Your Behalf Our founder, a former dealership manager with over 10 years of experience, knows exactly how to negotiate the best price so you don't have to waste hours (or overpay).
why.p3: Works With All Credit Types Good credit, bad credit, or even no credit — no problem. We provide guaranteed approval options tailored to your situation.
why.p4: No Hidden Fees • No Pressure • No Dealership Games We work exclusively for you — never for the dealer or insurance company.
why.p5: Time is the Real Cost From start to finish, everything is handled for you. You simply choose the car you love and we deliver it right to your doorstep with the best price and coverage already in place.

faq.title: Common Questions
faq.subtitle: If you do not see your question here, call or send the form above and we will answer it directly.
faq.q1: What does a broker do that I cannot do myself?
faq.a1: We negotiate with dealers and shop insurance carriers on your behalf, then hand you the numbers side by side. You skip the back and forth and the hours spent at dealerships.
faq.q2: Do you charge me a fee?
faq.a2: No hidden fees and no pressure. We work for you, not for the dealership or the insurance company.
faq.q3: What if my credit is not great?
faq.a3: We work with every credit situation, including limited or no credit history, and match you with lenders suited to your profile.
faq.q4: Can I get the car and the insurance together?
faq.a4: Yes. Handling both is what we do best, and it means your coverage is in place the day the vehicle is delivered.
faq.a5: New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania. Vehicles are delivered to your door.
faq.q6: How soon will I hear back?
faq.a6: Send the form and we follow up during business hours, Monday through Sunday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

brief.title: What We Do
brief.subtitle: Everything involved in getting you into the right car, handled by one broker.
brief.leasing: Leasing done right. We model the full cost of every offer — money factor, residual, fees — and lock in terms that actually make sense for how you drive.
brief.financing: Tell us the make, model, and trim. We source it across our dealer network and negotiate the out-the-door price down — then hand you the keys.
brief.delivery: Your car arrives at your door. No showroom, no sales floor.
brief.insurance: Top carriers compared for the right coverage at the lowest rate.
brief.usedcars: We locate the exact vehicle you want and negotiate the price for you.
brief.tradein: Most buyers lose money on the trade-in without realizing it. We benchmark your vehicle’s true value and make sure it’s credited fairly against your deal.

mission.title: Our Mission Statement
mission.gauge: Where we put the needle on every deal.
mission.p2: The dealership model is built to favor the dealership. Information is hidden, time is a tactic, and the person across the desk is paid to maximize what you spend. We flip that on its head.
